item.title: CKB Talk Daily Brief - 2026-10-29
item.description: ## 今日发生了什么 今天论坛的主要动静集中在 Myelin 的争议结算问答、CrowdCell 资助投票落地与首笔付款，以及 CKBSwap、CellScript 等开发进展上 [S01, S02, S03, S04, S08, S09, S10]。CrowdCell 投票以 100% 通过，总投票权重为 184,132,635 CKB、共 15 名投票者，并完成首笔 1,086,957 CKB 付款 [S03, S04, S05]。同时，Seedsong 支付第二期 50 美元（33,968 CKB），Kirea Finance 仍在催票以达 quorum [S06, S07]。 ## 重点话题 Myelin 讨论到 court verifier 上线后的结算路径：有人问应用能否用普通 CKB 交易结算单个争议 chunk 而不信任委员会，回复称这是预期设计，普通交易可独立验证有界争议块，但玩家资金还需可用证据和 escrow 规则来执行裁决 [S01, S02]。 CrowdCell 投票结果为 PASSED，批准率 100%、总权重 184,132,635 CKB、15 名投票者，达到批准门槛和最低参与要求；随后公布首笔付款 1,086,957 CKB，并有成员确认第二次审查的四个小修复及对应 exploit 测试已加入 [S03, S04, S05]。 Kirea Finance 作者称投票即将结束，但仍需更多投票权重达到 quorum；项目定位为 CKB 上开源、合规门控的 RWA 借贷基础设施，链上流程无桥、无托管 [S07]。 CKBSwap...

item.title: Introducing Myelin: a CKB-aligned off-chain Cell session runtime (2 posts)
item.description: Great work on this! so I’ve been reading this closely. One question about the court path, once the on-chain court verifier is live, could an application settle a single disputed chunk with a normal CKB transaction, without trusting the committee? I think that would make Myelin usable even for sessions where players have funds at stake. Hi @Kaylah, yes , that is the intended design: a normal CKB transaction would verify a bounded disputed chunk independently of the committee. For players’ funds, the application also needs available evidence and escrow rules that enforce the verdict, allowing challenges and withdrawals without fresh committee approval. Myelin already produces the evidence...

item.title: [DIS] CrowdCell: From Testnet Demo to a Crowdfunding Product on CKB | CrowdCell：把 CKB 测试网上的免信任众筹做成产品 (3 posts)
item.description: Based on the Metaforo tally at close, the outcome is PASSED. Approval is 100%, with total voting weight of 184,132,635 CKB from 15 voters. Both the approval threshold and minimum participation requirement are met. Post-close verification was completed on 28 October 2026 using CKB DAO Watchdog, together with a manual sanity check. The verification cross-checks Metaforo-recorded voting weights against on-chain Nervos DAO deposit weights. In this run, all voters’ totals match exactly. item.title: [DIS] Kirea Finance: Native RWA Lending Infrastructure for CKB |【DIS】Kirea Finance：面向 CKB 的原生 RWA 借贷基础设施 (1 posts)
item.description: Hey everyone, voting on Kirea Finance closes soon, and I still need more voting weight to reach quorum! Kirea Finance is building open-source infrastructure for compliance-gated RWA lending directly on CKB, with no bridge and no custodian in the on-chain flow. The full lending lifecycle (deposit → borrow → repay → release) is already implemented and tested on the CKB testnet. This $7,250 grant will help harden the contracts, integrate live Sumsub KYC, and deliver reusable tooling for other CKB developers. item.title: Introducing CKBSwap — Building on CKB for the Long Term (2 posts)
item.description: I think batcher is good. I seen the same model and dex on cardano. minswap.org great to know that. I think for the production launch, the hot cell issue is a must-fix problem. otherwise people won’t take it seriously. the cardano batcher solution seems practical. thanks @longdevbf I think DeFi might not be the killer app for CKB, but it definitely is something we need to have, as some sort of ecosystem primitive pieces. the current UX/UI looks clean, keep the great work!

item.title: CellScript - A DSL for Cell-Based Contracts (1 posts)
item.description: CellScript 0.33 Alpha: A Major Step Forward for CellScript Contracts CellScript 0.33.0-alpha.1 is out, and #47, #48, #49 are now closed. This is one of the largest steps forward CellScript has taken. The release brings together the work since 0.31, including the intervening 0.32 development work. It opens up a much wider range of contracts we can write on CKB, and it needs more time in real applications. That is why this is an alpha. The feature set is now frozen. The next stage is to test, simplify, repair and consolidate what we have.
